messages:
Meera: Day 2 async check-in
- What I did: imaged laptop, cloned repo, followed quickstart, ran `make dev` to bring up UI, completed onboarding tasks up to env/access.
- Blockers: can't pull base image (401), gcloud auth seems to return 403s, kubeconfig doesn't show dev cluster so can't port-forward; MFA weirdness.
- Today: unblock registry+auth so I can run local e2e and open my first docs PR.

Sam: @Meera welcome! Quick tries:
```
gcloud auth login --brief
# then
gcloud auth application-default login
```
If you still see 403 paste the error. For registry try `docker login registry.redwood.ai`. If you're behind SSO you might need `aws sso login --profile redwood` first.

infra: Created ticket INF-789 and granted dev-k8s-viewer role; run:
```
aws sso login --profile redwood && kubectl config use-context dev-cluster && kubectl get namespaces
```
Let us know the output if it errors.

Meera: Ran `aws sso login` — success. `docker login` returns `Error: unauthorized: authentication required`. `gcloud` commands still show `403: Permission denied`. kubectl shows no dev namespace yet.

deploy-bot: Provisioning tokens for Meera (pv-2026-03-17-13) — will DM creds when ready.

Sam: If ECR is involved try:
```
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
```
We also mirror some base-images to Docker Hub; I'll push a temp image you can pull if ECR blocks persist.

infra: Meera, I see missing RBAC for port-forward/exec. Applied temporary ClusterRoleBinding CRB-temp-312 to grant you port-forward in `meera-dev`. Try:
```
kubectl port-forward svc/dev-api 8080:80 -n meera-dev
```

Meera: Port-forward succeeds now, can hit http://localhost:8080 — thanks! Docker still fails with:
`unauthorized: authentication required: failed to fetch anonymous token`

Sam: Pushed `redwood-dev/meera-sandbox:dev-latest` to Docker Hub — try `docker pull redwood-dev/meera-sandbox:dev-latest` and run the sandbox until infra sorts ECR.

Meera: Pulled sandbox and ran tests. Opening a small docs PR after lunch. Will paste link for review.

Liz: Hi Meera, I'm Liz (People Ops). Scheduled 15m office hours at 11:30 PT — join if you'd like a walkthrough for VPN/MFA. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Meera: Joining 11:30. Thanks everyone — pinging if anything else pops up.
